Is Beyond Meat/Impossible Meat unhealthy?
No individual food item is “healthy” on its own.
The one criticism I have of Beyond and Impossible meats is that they contain about four times as much sodium as meat does.
From an individual health perspective, that can be bad, particularly for those who already have hypertension.

In most other ways, they are pretty similar to meat, so if you have low or normal blood pressure, that’s not a concern, but if you have high blood pressure, or any other health condition that inspired your doctor to restrict your salt intake, they might be a bad choice.
